Quick notes after the call this morning — pulling threads so we have a clear gap list to send to Acme: 

- Egress whitelist: Claire asked whether we can proxy telemetry through a customer-managed egress collector. Short answer: yes, with our private control plane you can route metrics/logs to your collector, but onboarding requires an allowlist for the control plane's health checks and KV prefetch endpoints.
- KV cache: we recommended a local shard per rack + prefix caching. Action: provide cache re-warm endpoint list (Jonas).
- mTLS & certs: Acme wants mutual TLS between control plane and data plane agents when using private control plane. Need to confirm rotation frequency and whether we support CA-signed certs from their vault (Irene).
- Network ACLs / SNAT: For airgapped deployments, discuss optional NAT gateway placement and whether we can operate in a fully isolated mode (no outbound) for inference if pre-warmed caches and model shards are present — this is an operations constraint (Rishi to doc).

I'll compile a one-page gap analysis and send to Claire by EOD.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
